title: Recover macOS LaunchAgent after an interrupted automatic update.
changes: Retry the owner-scoped launchd bootstrap and kickstart with bounded waits when a transient job handoff fails (including observed status 37); verify that the agent job actually reports running.
Do not execute dependent launchctl actions after an unconfirmed bootstrap and do not report a scheduled reload as an already restarted service.
Preserve device pairing, the owner-only supervisor, existing Windows updater safety fences, existing runtime tool permissions and the DLL-free source-only package profile.

WebRTC native workers are still separate unsigned QA artifacts, not bundled by public npm; end-to-end encryption for general ReMCP control is NOT implemented and remains fail-closed when required. Remote keyboard/mouse/clipboard over the WebRTC pilot are NOT enabled in production.
